description:
Marciana on a graduation trip with her students. Embarrassed by the daring design of her swimsuit, she decided to wear a penguin costume to cover herself.
The Penguin Squad protecting her is a surprise gift from Rei.

lines.text: It's reassuring having the Penguin Squad with us.
Um... Could you please not call me a penguin?
I am always prepared to help my students.
It makes me self-conscious when you stare at me like that. Are you curious about my penguin outfit?
Oh dear, this outfit keeps slipping down... Um, i-it's nothing.
Do you like penguins too, Commander? I adore them.
You go ahead. I'll stay here and keep watch.
Will you be much longer, Commander? It's just... the Penguin Squad was wondering when you'd be back.
Let's avoid going near the school. I'd rather not run into my students dressed like this.
Rei gave me this Penguin Squad as a gift. Aren't they adorable?
Wearing this makes it rather difficult to use my hands.
S-sorry, but I can't take off the penguin outfit.
This should come in very handy for my classes.
The Penguin Squad is growing right alongside me too.
I can be of even greater help to my students going forward. Thank you.
The Penguin Squad is going to love this.
I wasn't expecting this. When did you have time to prepare this?
You know precisely what I like... I'm truly grateful.
I am always grateful to you.
I want to continue being someone you can depend on, Commander.
Would it be all right if I stayed by your side a little longer? I'd like that.
Penguin Squad, are you ready?
Well then, shall we get going?
Please come this way.
Let's begin class.
Let's go, Penguin Squad!
I'll show you the power of penguins!
